summary_points: This document outlines specifications for field-applied paint on a Solana project.
It includes notices about alternate billing cycles, extended payment provisions, and certification periods.
Instructions require initialing on cover sheets and identifying revisions in the body of the specification.
The scope covers surface preparation and application of coatings and paint in the field.
General requirements include proper material delivery, storage facilities, labor provision, and adherence to codes.
Certain materials are excluded from painting, and operations must comply with safety regulations.
Drop-cloths are used to protect surfaces during painting.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles, extended payment and certification periods.
Paint application is restricted to dry surfaces above dew point temperature.
Surface preparation varies for different materials like carbon steel, stainless steel, and pre-painted steel.
Stainless steel requires special care during cleaning and sandblasting.
Uncoated carbon steel surfaces must be prepared according to paint standards.
Shop primed surfaces need cleaning before applying topcoat.
High-temperature paint requires heat curing and touch-up after cure.
Inter-coat contamination must be cleaned before applying subsequent coats.
The contract allows for alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Painting surfaces must be prepared using solvent cleaning, air blast, or brush blast.
Touch-up painting is required for shop-painted items with damaged areas.
Quality control involves visual inspection of surface preparation and paint application.
Environmental conditions must not deter the quality of the finished product.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Owner can request payment within 180 days after certification and approval.
Owner can certify and approve billings and estimates within 30 days.
Painted surfaces must meet film thickness specifications and visual quality standards.
Defective work must be corrected promptly by the contractor.
Final touch-up is required before leaving the job site.
Surface preparation details are provided in Section 3 of the specification.
